findings.claim: Both new routes are unauthenticated address lookups and neither attaches a rate-limiting guard, so a single call to the batch route fans out up to 20 upstream Transaction Service requests with no per-caller bound. A dedicated rate limit guard should be added under the tokens routes with its own max/windowSeconds and applied to the controller.

The chainId route parameters on both new handlers use a bare numeric string schema instead of the chain ID schema, deviating from the pattern that limits that bare schema to pre-existing routes. Both handlers should validate chainId using the ChainIdSchema via ValidationPipe instead.

The maximum batch size enforced before the upstream fan-out is a hardcoded literal rather than a named, configuration-driven value, which the caching/performance rule requires. It should be moved into the configuration entity and schema, exposed as an environment variable, added to the env sample, and read via the configuration service.
